items.title: Coca-Cola Shakes up Leadership, Names Pharma Veteran as CFO
items.summary: Coca-Cola Company (NYSE:KO) announced Monday the appointment of David Elkins as its incoming executive vice president and chief financial officer, effective April 2, 2027. Elkins will succeed John Murphy, who plans to retire in 2027 after nearly four decades with the beverage giant. Murphy, who has been CFO since 2019, will continue serving as president, supporting the CFO transition and advancing key enterprise priorities during 2027.
